description: {{title}}'s declared vocabulary -- the canon dictionary, in the shape
validator reads it: a flag written anywhere in the content must appear
here or be read somewhere, and a gate on a flag nothing writes is an
error either way. ending_gallery_unlocked is the teaching case: the
CLIENT reads it to unlock the ending gallery, so no YAML ever tests it,
and declaring it here is how a story says 'this write has a reader you
cannot see from the data'. Add every flag your decks and endings write.
